headline: LDA Freezes All Transactions in 485-Hectare Wellness City Phase-1
description: LDA officially stopped buying, selling and registration of land in the entire 485-hectare Phase-1 area of the Wellness City project. Hundreds of plot holders are now unable to register or transfer their properties.

headline: LDA Bulldozes 2 Bigha Illegal Plotting in PGI Area, Seals Commercial Building in Mohanlalganj
location: PGI Area (Kisan Path) and Harkanshgarhi, Mohanlalganj, Lucknow
description: LDA enforcement zone-2 team ran a bulldozer on 2 bighas of illegal plotting being developed along Kisan Path in the PGI area. Simultaneously, an illegal commercial construction in Harkanshgarhi, Mohanlalganj was sealed for being built without an approved map.

headline: 15 Bigha Illegal Plotting Demolished in Chinhat and BKT Amidst Strong Protest
location: Chinhat and Bakshi Ka Talab (BKT), Lucknow
description: LDA enforcement teams carried out a major demolition drive against illegal plotting spread over 15 bighas in Chinhat and BKT. The action was completed despite severe protests from local land developers and encroachers.

headline: Massive 87 Bigha Illegal Plotting Demolished in Dubagga and Sairpur
description: In a large-scale crackdown, LDA teams bulldozed illegal plotting networks spread across 87 bighas in Dubagga and Sairpur areas. Temporary structures, boundary walls, and unapproved roads were completely dismantled.

headline: 6 Illegal Plottings Bulldozed in Sushant Golf City and Dubagga
location: Sushant Golf City and Dubagga, Lucknow
description: LDA took strict action against unauthorized real estate developers by demolishing 6 illegal plottings in the premium Sushant Golf City area and Dubagga.

headline: LDA Plans to Demolish Old Buildings and Build New Complexes Across City
description: LDA announced a major urban renewal plan to demolish old and dilapidated buildings across the city and replace them with modern commercial complexes. Residents in targeted zones face potential displacement.

headline: 80 Bigha Illegal Empire Demolished in Naimishnagar and Kakori
description: LDA bulldozers razed an 80-bigha illegal plotting empire in Naimishnagar and Kakori. The land was being sold by a mafia network as LDA-approved plots. Boundary walls and internal roads of the unauthorized colonies were completely dismantled.

headline: 14 Illegal Plottings Demolished in Chinhat, Indira Nagar, Kakori and Dubagga
location: Chinhat, Indira Nagar, Kakori, Dubagga, Lucknow
description: In a major multi-zone enforcement drive, LDA demolished 14 illegal plottings being developed without layout approval. The action included clearing a 30-bigha area with seven plottings in Shivri (Kakori) and a 10-bigha area in Goila and Rasoolpur (Chinhat and Indira Nagar).

headline: LDA Acts Against Illegal Colony in Gudamba — 40 Bigha Demolished
description: LDA demolished an illegal colony spanning 40 bighas in Gudamba. The developer had created fraudulent layout plans resembling LDA-approved schemes to mislead buyers, causing hundreds of plot buyers to lose their investments.
impact: 40 bigha demolished · Hundreds of buyers defrauded

headline: Over 5,000 Properties Face Sealing or Demolition for Commercial Misuse
description: LDA issued a massive city-wide warning targeting 5,103 residential properties found operating commercial activities (banquet halls, large restaurants, etc.) without approval. Owners face sealing or demolition if they fail to comply with the 2025 building bylaws.

headline: LDA Orders Demolition of Park and Gazebo in Parsvnath Planet
description: LDA issued a demolition notice to the resident welfare association of Parsvnath Planet in Vibhuti Khand for constructing a children's park and gazebo over 4,000 sq ft, citing it as an unapproved layout violation. The notice sparked massive protests from residents.
impact: 4,000 sq ft park and gazebo targeted

headline: LDA Demolishes 3 Illegal Plottings in Kakori — 25 Bigha Cleared
description: LDA enforcement teams demolished three unauthorized plottings covering 25 bighas in the Kakori area. Buyers were left stranded after the bulldozer action dismantled roads and boundary markers.

headline: 7 Illegal Plottings Demolished in Gosainganj and Kakori; 4 Commercial Buildings Sealed
description: LDA conducted a multi-zone drive demolishing 7 illegal plottings covering 50 bighas (30 bighas in Sonai Kajehra, Gosainganj; 20 bighas in Bhadoi, Kakori). Four illegal commercial constructions were simultaneously sealed in Aliganj and Madiyaon for lacking approved layout maps.

headline: LDA Clears 43.75 Acres of Illegal Development in Gudamba and Kakori
description: In a massive anti-encroachment drive, LDA enforcement knocked down 12 illegal construction sites covering 43.75 acres. Zone-5 targeted 12.5 acres in Kapasi (Gudamba), while Zone-3 cleared 31.25 acres across Jaliyamau, Kathingra, Fatehganj, and Nathora (Kakori).

headline: Anant Nagar Demolished Without Notice — Residents Allege Sudden Action
description: LDA launched a sudden demolition drive to reclaim land for its Anant Nagar housing scheme, razing boundaries and temporary structures of around 35 houses. Residents claimed no prior notice was given, leading to a heavy police deployment and standoff.

headline: 6.75 Lakh Sq Ft Razed in Palm Paradise Colony; 9 LDA Engineers Face Action
location: Indira Nagar (Chandan) and Jankipuram Extension (Tiwaripur), Lucknow
description: LDA cracked down heavily on Palm Paradise Title Colony, razing unauthorized roads, boundary walls, and infrastructure across 6.75 lakh sq ft. An additional 1.08 lakh sq ft was cleared in Tiwaripur. Nine LDA enforcement engineers face strict action for allowing the illegal construction.
impact: Nearly 8 Lakh sq ft cleared · 9 engineers penalized

headline: 14 Illegal Plottings Demolished in Chinhat, Kakori & Dubagga — 17 Constructions Sealed
description: LDA demolished 14 illegal plottings across Chinhat, Kakori and Dubagga in a single day and sealed 17 constructions including commercial complexes. Enforcement teams from multiple zones participated in the joint drive.
impact: 14 plottings razed · 17 sealed including commercial complexes

headline: High Court Orders Demolition of Illegal Sliding Gates in Eldeco Udyan-II
location: Samriddhi Colony, Eldeco Udyan-II, Raebareli Road, Lucknow
description: Following a PIL, the Allahabad High Court directed the Nagar Nigam and LDA to take immediate steps to demolish illegal cemented sliding gates constructed by an RWA that were blocking a public road and hindering emergency vehicles in Eldeco Udyan-II.
impact: Illegal RWA gates/pillars targeted for demolition

headline: LDA Bulldozes 10 Illegal Plottings in Gosai Ganj and Dubagga
description: LDA enforcement teams used bulldozers to demolish 10 illegal plottings in Gosai Ganj and Dubagga. The plottings were being sold by land mafias to unsuspecting buyers who had no recourse after demolition.

headline: Demolition Ordered for Non-Compoundable Construction in Gomti Nagar
location: Plot No. 3/98, Vikrant Khand, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow
description: The Prescribed Authority of LDA issued a demolition order targeting unauthorized, non-compoundable construction at a residential plot in Vikrant Khand, Gomti Nagar. The demolition was temporarily stayed by the High Court pending a compounding review.

headline: 100 Bigha Illegal Colony Demolished — Land Mafia Ultimatum Broken
description: LDA demolished over 100 bigha of illegal plotting operated by a land mafia network. Boundary walls, entry gates, and basic infrastructure of the unauthorized colony were completely razed. The developer had collected money from hundreds of buyers.

headline: LDA Targets 15-Feet Road Encroachment in Kalyanpur Village
description: LDA Enforcement Zone-5 issued a demolition notice (Case No. 452 of 2021) directing residents in an unregularized colony in Kalyanpur to self-demolish unauthorized residential constructions encroaching on a 15-feet wide public road, leading to a legal dispute in the High Court.

headline: 7 Illegal Plottings Razed in Gosainganj, 6 Commercial Buildings Sealed
location: Gosainganj, Saadatganj, Dubagga, South City, Lucknow
description: LDA demolished 7 illegal plottings over 30 bighas in Gosainganj (Dularmau and New Jail Road). In addition, 6 unauthorized commercial constructions were sealed across Saadatganj, Dubagga, and Sultanpur Road.

headline: Massive 180 Bigha Mega-Drive: 17 Illegal Plots Razed Across City
location: Sushant Golf City, Dubagga, Madiyaon, Gudamba, Kakori, Lucknow
description: LDA cleared 17 illegal plots spanning over 180 bighas in a multi-zone strike. Areas targeted included 90 bighas in Sushant Golf City/BBD, 56,000 sqm in Dubagga, 60 bighas in Madiyaon, and 18,000 sqm in Gudamba.

headline: Illegal Chicken Market Razed in Gomti Nagar Extension on LDA Land
location: Sector-1, Gayatri Puram, Gomti Nagar Extension, Lucknow
description: LDA and police teams bulldozed 20 illegally constructed tin-shed shops operating as an unauthorized chicken market. The drive cleared 2,500 sq meters of encroached land in front of the railway line.

headline: 14 Illegal Plottings Demolished Including 'Saubhagya City' in Mohanlalganj
location: Mohanlalganj, Gosainganj, Dubagga, Kakori, Sairpur, Lucknow
description: LDA bulldozed 14 illegal plottings in a single day. Key clearances included the 15-bigha 'Saubhagya City' colony in Mohanlalganj, 12 bighas in Kakori, and multiple plottings in Dubagga and Sairpur (Naimish Nagar scheme).

headline: LDA Bulldozes Two Illegal Plottings Spanning 7 Bighas in Sairpur
description: Enforcement Zone-4 carried out demolition action against two illegal plotting sites being developed over 7 bighas of land in Palhari village, Sairpur area, without LDA layout approval.

headline: LDA Clears Plotting in BKT, Seals Unapproved Commercial Building in Gomti Nagar
location: BKT and Vipul Khand (Gomti Nagar), Lucknow
description: LDA demolished illegal plotting structures in Bakshi Ka Talab (BKT). Concurrently, a commercial building ('World Iron' premises) spanning 200 sqm in Vipul Khand, Gomti Nagar, was sealed for violating the approved map.

headline: LDA Demolition Team Faces Heavy Protests and Uproar in BKT
location: Vishrampur and Bhauli Villages, BKT, Lucknow
description: An LDA enforcement team faced severe backlash and an uproar from plot owners and locals while attempting to demolish illegal plotting in Bhauli, BKT. The situation escalated to the police station before an MLA intervened to mediate.

headline: 43 Bigha Illegal Plotting Demolished in Sushant Golf City and Gosainganj
location: Sushant Golf City and Gosainganj, Lucknow
description: LDA Enforcement Zone-1 and Zone-2 demolished four major illegal plottings covering 43 bighas. This included a 10-bigha plotting in Sonai Kajehra (Sushant Golf City) and three separate plottings in Malauli (Gosainganj) spanning 16 bighas, 8 bighas, and 6 bighas.

headline: 15 Illegal Plottings Demolished in Gudamba, Chinhat, Sairpur, Dubagga & Kakori
location: Gudamba, Chinhat, Sairpur, Dubagga, Kakori, Lucknow
description: In a massive coordinated drive, LDA demolished 15 illegal plottings across 5 zones. Key clearances included 12,000 sqm in Seevan (Gudamba) and 20,000 sqm in Naubasta Kala (Chinhat), along with multiple unauthorized structures in Kakori and Dubagga.

headline: 6 Illegal Colonies Bulldozed in Kakori and BKT Including 'Shagun City'
description: Zone-3 and Zone-5 enforcement teams demolished 6 unauthorized colonies. In Kakori, this included 'Shagun City' and two other plots. In BKT, three plottings totaling over 17,000 sqm were destroyed in Achramau village following specific court orders.
impact: 6 colonies demolished · 17,000+ sqm cleared in BKT

headline: LDA Demolishes 6 Illegal Plottings in Mohanlalganj and Gudamba
description: LDA bulldozers cleared 6 illegal plottings across two zones. The drive dismantled 23 bighas of illegal development across three sites in Shivdhara (Mohanlalganj) and another 27,000 sqm across three sites in Paikamau and Palka (Gudamba).

headline: 100 Bigha Mega Demolition: 13 Illegal Plottings Razed in Indira Nagar and Dubagga
description: LDA enforcement teams bulldozed 100 bighas of illegal plotting. This included 'Om Sai Green City' and 8 other plottings covering 70 bighas in Indira Nagar, and 4 plottings covering 30 bighas in Sarai Premraj, Dubagga.

headline: 13,000 Sqm Illegal Colonies Bulldozed in BKT and Chinhat
description: LDA cleared an 8,000 sqm illegal colony being built in Asti village (BKT) and a 5,000 sqm illegal plotting site in Ganeshpur (Chinhat). Municipal teams simultaneously cleared 100+ roadside encroachments in Thakurganj.

headline: 52 Bigha Plotting Demolished in Gosainganj and Sairpur Scam
description: LDA demolished unauthorized plots covering 50 bighas in Gosainganj and 2 bighas in Sairpur. Sellers had exploited a genuine 17-bigha approved layout to fraudulently market unapproved plots across a massive 150-bigha surrounding area.
impact: 52 Bighas cleared · Massive layout fraud halted

headline: 30 Bigha Illegal Plotting Razed in Chinhat by Shivaansh City Group
location: Loulai and Pusu Ka Purva, Chinhat, Lucknow
description: LDA Zone-1 and Zone-2 teams destroyed 3 illegal plottings developed over 30 bighas by Shivaansh City Group and others. A separate illegal structure encroaching on the green belt in Sushant Golf City was also removed.
impact: 30 Bighas cleared · Green belt encroachment removed

headline: Gomti Nagar Marriage Lawn & Sairpur Row Houses Bulldozed
location: Gomti Nagar Ext, Sairpur, Wazirganj, Lucknow
description: LDA demolished an illegally operated marriage lawn in Gomti Nagar Extension. Concurrently, 4 unapproved row houses on a 400 sqm plot in Mubarakpur (Sairpur) were razed, and 4 commercial/residential buildings were sealed in Central Lucknow.
impact: Marriage lawn & 4 row houses razed · 4 buildings sealed

headline: 21 Illegal Row Houses Demolished Near Amausi Airport Aviation Zone
description: LDA completely demolished 21 fully constructed row houses situated within the restricted aviation zone near the Amausi Airport. The structures were cleared due to severe safety and location violations despite being sold to buyers.
impact: 21 row houses demolished in restricted zone

headline: 35 Bigha Illegal Plotting in Sushant Golf City Demolished
description: LDA conducted a major demolition drive targeting a 35-bigha illegal plotting network in the Sushant Golf City area. The colony was being actively marketed without any layout approval, rendering buyer investments worthless.

headline: 20 Bigha Razed in Sushant Golf City; Multiple Gomti Nagar Buildings Sealed
location: Sushant Golf City, Gomti Nagar, Chinhat, Lucknow
description: In one of the first major single-day actions of 2025, LDA demolished 20 bighas of illegal plotting across four colonies in Sushant Golf City. Concurrently, unapproved building structures in Gomti Nagar and Chinhat were sealed.

headline: 1,200+ Structures Razed on Kukrail Riverbed in Historic Akbar Nagar Clearance
description: In one of Lucknow's largest demolition drives, LDA completely cleared 24.5 acres of the Kukrail riverbed to develop an eco-tourism hub and riverfront. Heavy machinery and bulldozers razed approximately 1,169 illegal residential properties and over 100 commercial establishments, displacing over 1,800 families who were relocated under the PM Awas Yojna.
impact: 1,200+ structures razed · 24.5 acres cleared · 1,800 families relocated
source_name: The Hindu / The New Indian Express

headline: 400-Acre Mega Land Reclamation for Airport Expansion Amidst Clashes
location: Chaudhary Charan Singh International Airport (CCSIA) Area, Lucknow
description: Following an October Supreme Court ruling dismissing farmers' pleas, the LDA and airport authorities reclaimed a massive 400-acre area to construct a fourth terminal and an Aero City. The operation required heavy police deployment as authorities faced stiff resistance and clashes while rebuilding the boundary walls.
impact: 400 acres reclaimed · Mass displacement in Airport zone

headline: Demolition Notices Issued to 50 Houses Built in Restricted Air Funnel Zone
description: LDA issued strict demolition notices to 50 houses constructed directly next to the airport's boundary wall. Investigations revealed that a fraudulent builder had posed as the landowner and illegally sold plots to unsuspecting buyers within the highly restricted air funnel zone.

headline: Tragedy Strikes Amidst Ongoing Akbar Nagar Encroachment Clearances
description: During the ongoing demolition drive to clear the Kukrail riverbed under the Uttar Pradesh Urban Planning Act, LDA teams dismantled remaining low-income structures. The aggressive drive led to severe distress, culminating in a local tailor ending his life after his home was razed and his sewing machine seized by enforcement officials.
impact: Ongoing displacement of thousands · Severe public distress
source_name: Free Press Kashmir / The Observer Post

headline: LDA Demolition Order Challenged for Unauthorized Construction in Vivek Khand
location: Plot No. 1/12, Vivek Khand, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow
description: LDA issued a demolition order for an unauthorized construction in Vivek Khand, Gomti Nagar after finding it lacked a sanctioned map. The developer approached the High Court, which stayed the demolition pending a final decision on their compounding application.

headline: Supreme Court Upholds Akbar Nagar Demolition, Clearing Way for Kukrail Riverfront
description: The Supreme Court upheld the Allahabad High Court's ruling allowing the LDA to demolish over 1,100 illegal structures in Akbar Nagar to reclaim the Kukrail Riverbed. The court mandated that affected residents be relocated under PM Awas Yojana before bulldozing.

headline: Demolition Ordered for Illegal Banquet Hall on Sultanpur Road
description: LDA issued sealing and demolition orders against a large banquet hall operating without a sanctioned map in Kasimpur Biruha. The owners sought interim relief from the revisional authority, halting the immediate 3-day demolition notice.

headline: Stone-Pelting Halts LDA Demolition Drive Against Commercial Buildings in Akbar Nagar
description: An LDA enforcement team attempted to demolish three major illegal commercial buildings in Akbar Nagar ahead of the wider residential clearances. While the first two buildings were razed successfully, severe stone-pelting from local mobs forced the team to halt the drive.
impact: 2 commercial buildings razed · Drive halted by protests

headline: High Court Orders Eviction of Akbar Nagar Residents by March 31
description: The Allahabad High Court dismissed petitions from commercial and residential occupants of Akbar Nagar, ruling the structures were built illegally on government land (Kukrail Nala flood zone). The court set a hard deadline for residents to vacate ahead of the bulldozers.

headline: 250 Bigha Cleared: 15 Illegal Colonies Demolished for Mohan Road Scheme
description: In a massive five-day demolition drive, LDA completely razed 15 illegal colonies spread across 250 bighas in Kakori and Para. The action cleared the land acquired from Gram Kalia Kheda and Pyarepur for the upcoming 785-acre Mohan Road Housing Scheme.

headline: First Bulldozers Roll into Akbar Nagar; High Court Intervenes with Stay
description: LDA initiated a massive demolition drive against illegal settlements in Akbar Nagar I & II after rejecting 250 appeals. Bulldozers began razing structures under heavy police security before the Allahabad High Court issued an emergency stay order halting the drive till January 2024.

headline: LDA Bulldozes 7 Bigha Plotting in Mohanlalganj, Seals Buildings in Kakori and Para
description: LDA Enforcement Zone-2 cleared a 7-bigha illegal plotting site known as 'Anjani Nagar Society' near the Ultratech plant in Mohanlalganj. Simultaneously, unapproved commercial basements and three-story structures were sealed in Kakori and Para along the Agra Expressway service lane.

headline: Massive Show-Cause Notices Issued for Demolition of 1,000+ Akbar Nagar Homes
description: Under Section 27(1) of the UP Urban Planning and Development Act, LDA formally passed orders to demolish settlements in Akbar Nagar. Over 1,000 residents submitted replies opposing the notices, kicking off the largest anti-encroachment legal battle for the Kukrail Riverfront project.

headline: Illegal Construction on Graveyard Land Demolished in Bhadewan
location: Plot No. 153, Village Bhadewan, Karhita, Lucknow
description: Following a joint inspection by Revenue Authorities and LDA, enforcement teams demolished unauthorized concrete structures (rooms/boundaries) illegally built over a registered graveyard plot (Plot No. 153) belonging to the Improvement Trust.
